# point-index disk v2 golden fixtures

These immutable files were generated by the disk-version 2 inspection recipe
from the one-point attributed `clustered_ticks(1)` test Source. The bound
profile uses intensity `1/U16`, classification `6/U8`, and RGB
`16,17,18/U16`.

- `one-point.pidx` is a 440-byte complete artifact (`BLAKE3
  df525242a625203610b3b03988bd1af5c02532d7e713c4e722cb8c383f202648`,
  `SHA-256 c9800efe20bda5a57816add5772c035e906fce9fda800a5c9900e30bed3525dd`).
- `one-point.pidx.work` is the resumable work file after its single durable
  Source block, 386 bytes (`BLAKE3
  dd8e8177a7d89d091e4dcab7c3b90b2534ecc977558e17a350c33dc9ac1a3775`,
  `SHA-256 ce8f6486d64860178353dcdfd8575228667c3581d9f6080bc5db56e6a938216f`).

The persistence integration test opens and resumes these bytes without
rewriting the inputs. Keep these fixtures together with the immutable v1
family when adding later persisted versions.
